findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Almost a third of a Hanoi school lunch ends up i" → 3 lines (13 words, 54.4px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: Hero headline is 13 words ("Almost a third of a Hanoi school lunch ends up in the bin."). Gallery median is 5.
findings.fix: Say the one thing. Move the rest to the supporting line.

findings.message: 7 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "eaten thrown away (waste rate)" above "118"; "The brief" above "Our challenge"; "Aim and objectives" above "What we set out to achieve"; "Design thinking" above "Our journey in eight steps"; "Brief and rubric" above "Where to find each requirement"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: JetBrains Mono — e.g. "g", "01", "02", "03"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01", "02", "03", "04", "05", "06"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 15 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "MANA3021 Business Ethics · Team Mini Soc", "One school lunch, per child · Hanoi, 202", "The brief", "Our “How might we…” question").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 12 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: button#react-aria8422146750-_r_k_.group.relative → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | button#react-aria8422146750-_r_m_.group.relative → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | div.tray → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) 0px 1px 3px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) 0px 1px 2px -1px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 3 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.topbar 1440px | div#effort.effort 1088px | footer.site 1440px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 8 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 2 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (8, 4 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "Home" 4:1 needs 4.5:1; "Start the journey →" 4:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.

findings.message: 3 typefaces in use (Be Vietnam Pro, Bricolage Grotesque, JetBrains Mono).
findings.fix: Two at most.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 13.8px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: Only 1 picture(s) on the page (1 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 16 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 54.4px (3.8vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
findings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.

findings.message: 4 sections carry text but no heading: div.grid.g2 at 1122px (131 words); div.tbl at 1550px (137 words); div#homecards.dt at 2079px (181 words); div.tbl at 2828px (110 words)
findings.fix: Give each section a short heading that names what it holds (the menu, the rooms, how it works, the price), in the heading face at the section size.

findings.message: 1 text block(s) sit within 16px of the screen edge: "CampusMeal app" (9px from the right)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–32px or more). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.

findings.message: Only 0 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "Almost a third of a Hanoi school lunch ends up i" → 3 lines (13 words, 32px)

findings.message: 2 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.
